rules.statement: A quorum of 7 members was sufficient to constitute a valid meeting for the appointment of a principal in this pirivena, as per the agreement between the Sabha.
rules.supporting_quote: "I am therefore of opinion that a quorum of 7 was sufficient to constitute a valid meeting."

meta.parties: Morontuduwe Sri Naneswara Dhammananda Nayake Thero v. Baddegama Piyaratana Nayaka Thereo
